snippet.title: Hellmaster - Official  Trailer
snippet.description:
Dante Games is a blockchain gaming ecosystem based on Dante's Divine Comedy.
It features an innovative and deflationary circular economy that is self-sustainable in the long term.

Hellmaster: The Legend of Dante is the first game from Dante Games. It is a strategic role-playing card game that is dynamic, fun, and offers an immersive experience, relying on skill rather than luck for success.

Web: https://www.dantegames.com
Twitter: https://x.com/PlayDanteGames
Telegram: https://t.me/DanteGames
